title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: SBD > MR > R > R > PCM > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a brief but stellar early‑1970 set featuring an epic Dark Star and a flawless St. Stephen → Mason’s Children transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality, rare for 1970 material, delivering a vivid listening experience despite the tape being only a snippet of the full concert. Musically the show shines with a soaring 20‑minute Dark Star, a tight St. Stephen that segues into an inspired Mason’s Children, and a palpable fire from the band after their recent New Orleans bust‑up. While listeners lament the missing portions of the performance, the material present is consistently rated as exceptional.

ai_rating.rationale: Across more than a dozen detailed reviews the show and recording are both lauded; standout Dark Star and superb soundboard quality drive a high rating, with only minor deductions for the abbreviated length.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the SBD "great sounding," "sonic quality excellent," and note crisp, resonant audio typical of a high‑grade 1970 board tape. No major dropouts or distortion are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The snippet focuses on a high‑energy middle section: St. Stephen flows seamlessly into Mason's Children, leading into an expansive Dark Star that showcases the band's improvisational peak of early 1970.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo is described as "smoking," with emphatic praise for his interplay with Lesh and a refined, polished Dark Star.
